scripts.deploy: bun run build && npm exec --no -- cf deploy --prebuilt --mode production
scripts.deploy:preview: vite build --mode preview && npm exec --no -- cf deploy --prebuilt --mode preview
scripts.deploy:dry-run: bun run build && npm exec --no -- cf deploy --prebuilt --mode production --dry-run
scripts.deploy:preview:dry-run: vite build --mode preview && npm exec --no -- cf deploy --prebuilt --mode preview --dry-run
